purpose: Obtain one consolidated author decision for all author-owned frozen-plan inconsistencies discovered before S6-E0 red-contract preparation, while preserving zero formal FFE and the original frozen snapshot.

bound_frozen_plan.original_preservation_rule: The original frozen snapshot remains immutable historical evidence and may not be edited or replaced. Resolution must be additive, versioned, hash-bound and separately frozen.

supersession.reason: v0.1 covered only the M budget and H1 endpoint. v0.2 adds the canonical method-name conflict and machine-provenance reconciliation so the author is not asked to approve serial partial amendments.

conflicts_requiring_author_choice.question: Which per-run FFE budget governs the 12-problem, 7-variant, 30-seed mechanism stage M?

option_recommended.consequence: Matches PROJECT_PLAN, preregistration, target/failure-tree timing and frozen aggregate totals; only the conflicting synthetic-suite sentence requires additive supersession.

option_alternative.consequence: Matches the synthetic-suite sentence but adds 211,680,000 M FFE and requires broader versioned changes to budgets, checkpoints and aggregate totals.

conflicts_requiring_author_choice.question: Which timing and aggregation definition governs the primary H1 graph-recovery endpoint?

option_recommended.value: NMI at 25/50/75/100 percent fixed-budget checkpoints; inactive checkpoints equal zero; problem-level median
option_recommended.consequence: Matches PROJECT_PLAN, preregistration, experiment matrix, target chain and failure tree and keeps the frozen H1 branch thresholds directly executable.

option_alternative.value: NMI at first valid activation and time-weighted median over later valid graphs
option_alternative.consequence: Matches one synthetic-suite sentence but requires a precise time-weighting formula, broader plan changes and reconsideration of H1 thresholds.

conflicts_requiring_author_choice.question: Which full English name is canonical for CVGR-SHADE?

option_recommended.consequence: Matches the selected idea genealogy, author decision packet, novelty screening, mathematical method specification and human terminology table. The conflicting machine method/glossary locks are superseded additively.

option_alternative.consequence: Matches the two machine consistency locks but requires versioned changes to the selected idea identity, method specification, author-facing materials and future manuscript first use.

B.meaning: Resolve mechanism-stage M at 2,000D, retaining 52,920,000 M FFE and 270,120,000 M+C1+F FFE.

H.meaning: Resolve H1 at fixed 25/50/75/100 percent checkpoints with inactive checkpoints equal to zero and problem-level median NMI.

N.meaning: Resolve the canonical full name as Co-Violation Graph Recombination SHADE while retaining CVGR-SHADE as the abbreviation.

S.meaning: Prepare a versioned machine authority binding for the accepted plan and later implementation decisions; preserve historical PROPOSED/DRAFT/handoff=false artifacts and do not expand execution authority.

A.meaning: Prepare an additive amendment candidate, deviation entry, versioned consistency locks, provenance binding, hash manifest and verification receipt; do not auto-freeze them.

R.meaning: Keep the previous S6-E0 red candidate on hold and issue a new version only after the consistency amendment is independently frozen and restored.

G.meaning: Record local governance provenance only; do not configure a remote, push or publish.

E.meaning: Do not execute any optimizer, objective/constraint evaluator, benchmark, simulation, pilot, M, C1, F or C2.

F.meaning: Consistency resolution and amendment preparation create no formal run package and no formal FFE.

hard_stop_conditions: The author's B, H or N choice is absent, ambiguous or differs from the recorded candidate without an equivalent explicit decision.
Any original frozen artifact or snapshot byte would be edited, replaced or deleted.
The amendment changes any scientific fact beyond the selected M budget, H1 timing/aggregation and method full-name resolution.
The post-freeze binding expands authority beyond already accepted plan/implementation decisions or treats optimizer execution as authorized.
Any S6-E0 specification, fixture, red test or production module is created before the amendment has its own hash-bound freeze acceptance and restore evidence.
Any objective/constraint evaluation, optimizer run, formal run package or formal FFE occurs.
Any performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, novelty, physical-validation or paper-readiness claim is inferred from the resolution.

held_downstream_candidate.note: The held candidate remains immutable historical provenance and is not silently treated as authorized.

deferred_nonconflicting_gates: Exact parent FR-SHADE source/version/hash/license and conformance identity must be locked before evaluator-bearing implementation.

External contemporary constrained-optimizer baselines and a modern licensed benchmark remain required for a broad SCI performance claim; the frozen C1 alone supports only a bounded mechanism/internal-control claim.
Those gates are not silently added to this consistency amendment and will require their own evidence and author decision at the appropriate stage.

completion_boundary.author_choice_means: The three conflicting scientific facts have an author-selected intended resolution, and an additive amendment/provenance package may be prepared.
completion_boundary.author_choice_does_not_mean: The frozen plan is already amended, the amendment is frozen, S6-E0 red tests are authorized, an evaluator-bearing optimizer exists, or any experiment may run.
completion_boundary.next_gate: Prepare and verify the additive consistency amendment freeze candidate, then request separate author freeze acceptance and empty-directory restore authorization.
